dog.description_text:
Meet Indie – Spunky, Sweet, and Ready to Steal Your Heart!

Indie is full of charm and personality. She’s friendly with people, playful with other dogs, and always up for fun. Whether it’s zooming around the yard or curling up for cuddles, Indie brings energy and heart to everything she does.

She’s crate-trained and has a great foundation, though she's still learning the ropes when it comes to leash manners and house training. With a little patience and consistency, she’ll thrive in a home that’s ready to help her continue growing.

Rescued as a stray in Mississippi, Indie’s resilience and joyful spirit shine through. She’s ready to find a forever home that matches her spark and gives her the love she’s been waiting for.

Could Indie be the one for you?

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption. Please note that the listed location for this dog may not be accurate due to technical limitations of this database and we have transportation options available within 6 hours of NYC (so don't let location hold you back)!

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
